# pi 0.84.3 absence probes, 2026-08-26:
# 1. `pi --help` - no memory flags, no memory feature.
# 2. Package docs searched - no built-in memory capability. Session
#    persistence (--session/--session-id, explicit resume) is session
#    storage, not cross-session context memory.
# 3. The session_recall tool seen on this machine is a user-installed
#    extension (~/.pi/extensions/session-memory), not a pi built-in.
# Conclusion: pi has no built-in persistent memory; memory:false is
# vacuously true (empty render, nothing emitted).
